title: Nonnegativity of finite expectation
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $f:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $f(x)\ge 0$ for every $x\in\Omega$. Then $\sum_{x\in\Omega}p(x)f(x)\ge 0$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
